name: Chronic Eosinophilic Leukemia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO 2016 Diagnostic Criteria for Chronic Eosinophilic Leukemia

criteria.description: Persistent eosinophilia with absolute eosinophil count >1.5 x 10^9/L for more than 6 months
Evidence of clonal eosinophilic proliferation by cytogenetic or molecular abnormalities (e.g., PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1 rearrangements)
Bone marrow hypercellularity with increased eosinophilic precursors and blasts <20%
Exclusion of secondary/reactive causes of eosinophilia (e.g., parasitic infections, allergies)
Presence of organ dysfunction attributable to eosinophilic infiltration

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Persistent eosinophilia >1.5 x 10^9/L for >6 months, evidence of clonal proliferation, and bone marrow findings consistent with CEL after exclusion of reactive causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Molecular testing for PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1, and other rearrangements is critical for diagnosis and treatment planning.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Organ infiltration by eosinophils causing tissue damage
pathognomonic.notes: Commonly affects heart, lungs, skin, and gastrointestinal tract
searchTerms: tissue injury due to eosinophil infiltration

occasional.notes: Due to eosinophilic myocarditis or endomyocardial fibrosis

laboratory: Bone marrow hypercellularity with eosinophilic proliferation
Elevated serum vitamin B12 and tryptase levels
imaging: Splenomegaly on abdominal ultrasound or CT
Cardiac MRI showing eosinophilic infiltration or fibrosis
Chest X-ray or CT showing pulmonary infiltrates
genetic: PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1 gene rearrangements detected by FISH or PCR
other: Tissue biopsy showing eosinophilic infiltration and fibrosis

distinguishingFeatures: Blasts >20% in bone marrow or blood

redFlags: Signs of cardiac involvement (e.g., heart failure, arrhythmias)
Evidence of transformation to acute leukemia
references: Arber DA, et al. The 2016 revision to the World Health Organization classification of myeloid neoplasms and acute leukemia. Blood. 2016.
Gotlib J. World Health Organization-defined eosinophilic disorders: 2017 update on diagnosis, risk stratification, and management. Am J Hematol. 2017.
Tefferi A, et al. Chronic eosinophilic leukemia, not otherwise specified: 2019 update on diagnosis, risk stratification, and management. Leukemia. 2019.
